notes.title: Dullpain OST is Official Released!
notes.content:
In the town of "Dullpain," we encounter numerous stories, some fulfilling and some regretful. The soundtrack that runs through it also strikes a chord with many players. Now, we're excited to announce the release of the "Dullpain" OST!

The "Dullpain" game soundtrack, "OST," is exclusively available on STEAM, with no other platforms offering it for sale. Additionally, high-quality audio sources are not available outside of this platform.

The "Dullpain" Soundtrack includes a total of 48 tracks, featuring 3 vocal theme songs, as well as several unreleased and undisclosed original tracks.

It was collaboratively crafted by top-ten composer Edwin Tong from the 23rd Annual USA Songwriting Competition, R&B singer Lucy R from Spain, and game producer RAiNSE雨观 from Senshu University in Japan.

If you love the story and music of "Dullpain," feel free to click to make a purchase!

Furthermore, the "Dullpain" game itself will also be available at a 20% discount simultaneously!

notes.title: 游戏调整公告
notes.content:
致所有的玩家们，

感谢所有喜欢和支持《修理行》的玩家们，从立项到众筹，再到游戏上线，一路有很多曲折困难，也收获了很多感动和美好，这是一段值得珍藏的旅程。

notes.title: 《修理行》正式上线
notes.content:
就在今天！《修理行》正式上线！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918195/5d8fac3013f5a1d55fbd165423a1a12ce6c553e9.png[/img]

定价46元，首发折扣9折！在游戏中玩家将成为一家小修理铺的老板“景文”，通过潜藏在自己身上的特殊能力——“记忆修正”，重新体验他人的故事与经历，做出顺从内心的选择，填补那些一直深埋在心中的缺憾。

制作组埋月山枯此前开发过过两款视觉小说游戏，《爱人lover》和《依依》，而《修理行》是首次挑战横板的形式展现，让整个制作难度和量级都更上了一个台阶。

主线剧情以主角的特殊能力为引，将几位主要角色串联在一起，通过单元剧的形式，可主动操控8位角色，娓娓向玩家道来藏在每个角色背后的故事和情感。本作入围了“2022年“Indie Play最佳剧情”提名，所以在剧情内容上相信能让玩家们值得期待的！

希望你们都能喜欢这款多结局、多选择、多支线且复玩性很高的游戏

有任何建议欢迎到官方QQ群跟我们反馈 1077696242

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1954520/_/

notes.title: The story of the creation of the scene of "DullPain"---Yazhen Breakfast Shop
notes.content:
Wenzhou has a breakfast called glutinous rice, first the steamed glutinous rice thickly spread on the bottom of the bowl, and then sprinkled on top with crushed doughnuts (according to personal preference, you can put soft doughnut pieces or crunchy doughnut pieces), and then the savory minced meat soup poured on top, evenly dripping through the doughnuts and glutinous rice, and the soup topping has not only minced meat, but also diced shiitake mushrooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918195/db208209cafb0034f93c533cff15114e78f5cc9b.png[/img]

Glutinous rice is a long heritage of Wenzhou's special breakfast, but also the first choice of all Wenzhou people every day for breakfast.
Li Ya Zhen especially like to do business, although young, but with skilled cooking skills and civilian pricing, has long been a breakfast store in the town to run a sound.
This breakfast store, accompanied by many people to start a new day - also accompanied by, Jing Wen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918195/b702e6d30521a696c16816b5dd6b3b27feadfaf2.png[/img]

notes.title: 《修理行》场景创作故事之—— 酩酊餐厅
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918195/52175d65abc3f3390007ade8605675d8360bd069.png[/img]

The word "Moet" is not always appropriate for a restaurant, and a Chinese restaurant at that.
But perhaps it was originally a bar?
The owner, a Chinese man, is known as Wang, or "Jack" to some, but he's always thought that foreign name was too corny.

The restaurant has very few dishes, but it has gained a particularly loyal clientele.
Some people say that the fried rice is the best.
Some say that the xiao long bao here has a unique flavor.
Still others, just because they want to be here and meet someone ......
This has become his habit.

"I'm happy to meet you again and talk to you -
Of course, and then a cup of pu-erh tea, it would be better. "

notes.title: 《修理行》DEMO 正式公开上线！
notes.content:
玩家老爷们好呀~（最近我们出镜率很高哟）

上次的小规模内部测试之后，游戏受到了许多朋友的关注和喜爱，我们已经收集了测试中大家反馈得建议，对d游戏中出现的问题进行优化和修复，所以正值十一小长假，我们将正式公开DEMO供广大粉丝体验，之前没能体验到游戏的新老玩家都可以在假期间进行试玩。

同时还有两个好消息告诉大家！《修理行》入围了Indieplay中国独立游戏大赛“最佳叙事游戏”奖项，撒花撒花~~

《修理行》作为一款横板的叙事游戏，游戏有着丰富的故事线，多个结局和互动细节，玩家可以通过主角“记忆修正”的能力进入他人的记忆，穿梭中外古今的世界，揭开围绕自己的谜团。游戏虽然由埋月山枯老师一个人独立开发制作，但无论从剧情体量，精美的人物、场景设计都表现出了满满的诚意，并且本作与大多同类型以悬疑、恐怖的主流内容不同，突出的是人间烟火的温情，现实生活中的细微情感，引发玩家思考，如果能修改记忆，对现在的生活是好还是坏呢？

除了入围了奖项，《修理行》众筹页面在后面也将上线摩点平台，我们与埋月大大精心设计了不同的支持档位，包含不同种类的精美周边，更有机会可以直接参与游戏内容，与埋月大大一同在游戏中设计专属于你的故事！

喜欢这部作品的朋友赶紧加入愿望清单，感谢各位玩家老爷们的支持，祝大家国庆快乐！！

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1954520/_/

notes.title: 正式公开，招募限量测试中
notes.content:
Dullpain is a 2D side-scrolling, interaction and storytelling game developed by one person. Its Steam page is open now!

The game is a Chinese side-scrolling and narrative game. Jingwen, the male protagonist, operates a repair shop his father gives to him. All story begins at the shop.
Yazhen Li, his childhood friend. Yinyin Lu, a naive and romantic girl.
Characters with different stories and separate dialogues come to the shop. 
Everything can be repaired. What about a heart? Your choice matters, as it will decide the destiny of every character, also story development and endings.
Time and space entangle. 8 independent and controllable characters encounter each other. Their destinies are intertwined. Immerse in the trauma of memory or get rid of sadness? Find the answer in Dullpain.
